newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Cricket-De Silva scores Shell Cup record century.
newsitem.headline: Cricket-De Silva scores Shell Cup record century.

text.p: Sri Lankan batsman Aravinda de Silva hit a whirlwind century from 64 balls as his Auckland side thrashed Canterbury by seven wickets on Sunday in New Zealand's one-day Shell Cup competition.
De Silva, who came to the wicket after Auckland had lost their first two wickets without scoring, smashed boundaries all around the ground on his way to the fastest hundred in Shell Cup history.
"He has quite a sore ankle at the moment and he said to me that for that reason he just tries to hit fours and sixes," Auckland captain Justin Vaughan said.
De Silva finished the match with a six as Auckland raced to 141 for 3 from just 21.3 overs in reply to Canterbury's 137 from 32.5 overs.
